notes:
Account summary: Strata Lingua Harbor builds an internal multilingual discovery layer for a global law firm network (contracts, briefs, filings). They're evaluation-stage for a vendor to run RAG search + high-quality reranking across 12 languages with strict EU data residency requirements.

Key requirements / constraints:
- Indexing scale: starting target 150M documents (paragraph-level), long term plan to reach ~1B paragraphs; 10s of TBs archived. Need multi-tenant sharding strategy and efficient incremental indexing.
- Languages of interest: en, fr, de, es, it, nl, pt, ja, ko, zh-Hans, ar, sv — require per-language recall/precision tuning and per-language evals.
- Retrieval architecture: prefer hybrid BM25 + dense ANN; reranker to be language-aware (fine-tuned cross-lingual reranker or language-specific small re-rank heads).
- Embeddings: exploring two approaches — single cross-lingual embedding (e.g., language-agnostic model) vs per-language specialized embeddings. Concerned about recall drop for low-resource languages (scandinavian + nordic dialects).
- Reranking latency SLO: target 95th percentile end-to-end search (retrieve + rerank + token-gen snippets) <= 350ms for short queries; strict tail latency for attorney-facing workflows.
- Cost targets: aiming for ~$0.008-0.015 per query (embeddings + rerank) at 150M doc scale; want cost/performance levers (quantization, batching, rerank top-K tuning).
- Model preferences: prefer an open model stack (7B-13B quantized conv / re-ranker fine-tune) for private deployment; open to Redwood-hosted evaluation but need Private deployment afterwards.
- Security/compliance: SSO/SAML, KMS integration, SOC2 compliance, audit logs for every query, 7+ year retention/archival policy for certain jurisdictional docs.
